findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A fix passes its first review, then a merge conflict is resolved and the review of that repair finds a P1. Close asks the owner immediately, although this is the first blocked review. `src/forge/close.py:384` records every completed review and line 407 counts all of them; the changed condition therefore reaches the default limit on this second review regardless of the first result. Conflict-repair reviews can report P1s (`src/forge/templates/review.md:504-507`). The coordinator's one-line ruling and the new regression test cover two consecutive blocked reviews, not this clean-then-blocked case. The complete promised item is: Fixes use task_review_rounds like story parts (default 2), so a fix stops for the owner only after its second blocked review; the skill and guide say so; new and existing repos get it on upgrade.

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - Pull request CI runs the required tests with the default review limit. The new behavior returns a worker-blocked refusal after the first P1, but tests still require an owner stop at that point: `tests/test_split_keeps_review_findings.py:49,63,106`, `test_owner_decides_at_the_round_limit.py:40`, `test_close_waits_for_review_loop_choice.py:27`, `test_review_loop_records_each_stop_choice.py:35`, `test_reviews_converge_on_changed_lines.py:70`, `test_react_review_rules.py:81`, `test_zod_rules.py:123`, `test_score_table.py:70`, `test_board_needs_you.py:93`, `test_queue_land_all.py:389`, `test_aha_review.py:69`, `test_mainonce_clash.py:108`, `test_accepted_records_reuse_green_ci.py:29`, `test_accepted_review_passes_first_pr_check.py:24`, `test_acceptance_publishes_final_review_once.py:23`, `test_merge_enable_mechanical_review.py:149`, `test_runner_without_gh.py:147`, `test_app_constitution.py:438`, `test_machine_views.py:143`, `test_board_runway.py:141`, and `test_failed_legacy_review_history.py:88`. Those latter paths are also under `tests/`. `tests/test_reads_wait_for_a_loop_choice.py:19` additionally requires the worker wording removed at `src/forge/worker.py:28`. The split tests are always selected by `.forge/always-tests.txt:5`; the other importers of the changed `test_close.py` are selected by `src/forge/fasttest.py:441-454`. These assertions conflict with the patch, so the required PR check will fail until they are updated.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - An owner consults the repository README to learn when a fix needs a decision. `README.md:139` and `README.md:193` still say a fix gets one review round, contradicting the updated skill and command guide. This leaves users expecting the very owner stop the change removes. The applicable rule says: "Replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change."
findings.title: Standard: Delete before adding

why: Fixes stop for the owner's choice after the first blocked review unless a finding is P0 (close.py uses a fixed limit of 1 for fixes), while story parts get task_review_rounds (default 2); at a client this cost an owner question and 20-60 minutes three times on 18 Nov 2026
